report.status_line: CRITICAL: Trailer water tank ruptured with ~360 L remaining, propane depleting before mission end, and ATVs 3 and 5 malfunctioning.

concerns.title: Trailer Water Tank Ruptured and Severe Water Shortage Risk
concerns.detail: Mission Support and crew confirmed the trailer water tank ruptured en route and needs replacement. The remaining water volume is ~360 L, which provides about 4.2 days of supply at the Arctic analog average rate (12.12 L/person-day) for 7 crew members, falling short of the 10 days remaining until mission end on 2015-01-23.

concerns.title: ATV 3 and ATV 5 Mechanical Failures
concerns.detail: ATV 3 powered on but shut down after 20 seconds, and ATV 5 failed to start completely. These failures limit crew mobility and impact readiness for the proposed Jan 14 EVA.

concerns.title: Propane Depletion Forecast Before Mission End
concerns.detail: Propane is at 40% and declining at -5 percent/day. At this rate, propane will be empty in ~8 days, before the scheduled mission completion in 10 days on 2015-01-23.

concerns.title: Habitat Hot Water Unavailable
concerns.detail: The crew reported that hot water has still not been attained in the habitat.

crew_actions: Begin strict water rationing to stretch the ~360 L reserve toward the NASA potable-water minimum rate.
Perform maintenance checks and troubleshooting on ATV 3 and ATV 5 to diagnose ignition and shutdown issues.
Adjust the setup covering with an extra mattress to secure ties more easily while wearing gloves.
Inspect habitat heating and plumbing systems to investigate why hot water has not been attained.
Monitor daily propane consumption to verify if the burn rate continues at -5 percent/day.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Authorize emergency replacement and resupply of the ruptured water trailer tank and transmit water shortage protocols.
decisions_for_earth.why: The habitat has ~360 L of water remaining, which will last about 4.2 days at the analog average rate with 10 days remaining until mission end on 2015-01-23.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Decide on approval for the requested Jan 14th 2015 EVA in light of vehicle failures.
decisions_for_earth.why: ATV 3 shut down after 20 seconds and ATV 5 failed to start completely, compromising operational transport safety.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Review propane resupply options or issue habitat heating conservation directives.
decisions_for_earth.why: Propane is at 40% and burning at -5 percent/day, projecting depletion in ~8 days before the mission finishes in 10 days.

report.message_to_earth: Habitat status is critical due to a ruptured water trailer tank threatening habitat water supplies. At 12:35pm the trailer tank ruptured en route, leaving ~360 L of total water, which lasts about 4.2 days for 7 crew members with 10 days remaining until mission end on 2015-01-23. The crew is restricting consumption and inspecting ATVs while awaiting shortage procedures. Diesel is nominal at 75%, propane is at 40% with ~8 days remaining at -5 percent/day, ATVs 3 and 5 are offline, and hot water is unavailable. Mission Control must authorize water replacement logistics and decide on the EVA requested for Jan 14th 2015 before tomorrow. The crew will report again tomorrow.
